extraction_scope: Worker-6 mechanism adjudication from local XML/PDF figures and supplementary ELEBA scheme; no unsupported exact figure quantification is promoted.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The three reviewed peptides have source-supported antimicrobial growth effects with peptide- and target-specific strength, but growth inhibition curves do not by themselves establish a molecular target.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact per-point growth values are figure/database annotations unless stated in prose; not treated as a separate mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SEM observations support peptide-associated microbial surface abnormalities and mammalian cell membrane damage under the tested conditions.
mechanism_claims.limitations: SEM supports morphology changes but does not quantify pore mechanism or a unique molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: ELEBA supports LPS/LTA binding for brevinin-2SSb and ranatuerin-2SSa, with stronger LPS than LTA affinity described for brevinin-2SSb.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Binding is specific to the reported endotoxin assay and should not be generalized to all antimicrobial mechanisms.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: ABTS assay results support antioxidant activity for brevinin-2SSb and weaker activity for ranatuerin-2SSa, while granuliberin-SSa was not active in that assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Antioxidant activity is recorded as an ancillary biochemical activity, not antimicrobial potency.
